endorsements.quote: Vendors should publish stress-test results across artifact categories – tissue artifacts, staining variations, scanning defects, rare morphological patterns – not merely average performance on curated test sets.

unlisted_practices: Assess return on investment of AI tools at the system level rather than per case, using metrics such as time per case, ancillary study ordering rates, turnaround times, user satisfaction, and burnout indicators.
Provide purpose-built companion verification tools for high-stakes primary AI systems as a prerequisite for safe clinical deployment.
Design AI outputs to be spatially localized and rapidly verifiable so clinicians can spot-check rather than exhaustively re-review.
Ensure AI tools accept and integrate structured clinical context and flag when critical clinical information is absent.
Involve pathologists in defining clinically relevant failure modes, acceptable boundaries of automation, and the contextual information an AI tool must integrate.

screen.reason: The paper presents a conceptual framework and commentary/guidelines based on cognitive load theory and implementation science for evaluating and governing AI tools in pathology workflows.
